en-US.author: David M. Anderson
en-US.description: The verbose ed, a drop-in ed clone with friendly errors and a built-in help system
en-US.name: ved
en-US.releaseNotes:
- README reads the toolchain from Cargo.toml and drops the engine's origin story; SECURITY.md names build-release
- Run CI by hand: workflow_dispatch instead of push and pull request
- Remove ship.conf; the release apps read ship.toml
- Let dist build without a release workflow
- Retire the release workflows
- Remove author and AI-assistance attribution; it belongs in source file headers
- Drop AI-assistance disclosure sentence from README/SECURITY footer
- Add dispatch-level tests for w, r, e, d, g/v, Q, and a/i/c setup
- Add test coverage for parse_args and the H (help) command
- Make the BRE engine character-aware, not byte-oriented
- Support /pattern/ and ?pattern? search addresses
- Refuse a substitution that splits a multi-byte UTF-8 character
- apt_repo, not apt_package
- Package versions stop coming from Dependabot
- Dependabot merges move to the organisation's sweep
- dist attaches to the release ship creates
- The profile is targets and names
- Retire the curl installer: apt, Homebrew, winget and cargo are the paths
- Dependabot: monthly, grouped, merged when every run on the commit is green
- Delete the Defender scan caller: the scan never predicted winget's validation
- Delete the release document: ship is the procedure
